item.title: [New] Message trace through Graph can now return the status recalled, but only when the request asks for unknown enum members
item.description:
A script that reads message trace through Graph without the Prefer header receives unknownFutureValue for a recalled message, so a recall after a phishing report or a data-loss mistake looks like an unclassified row. With the header, recalled messages can be counted and tied to the investigation that triggered them.

Graph · Add the Prefer: include-unknown-enum-members header to message-trace collectors that use Graph and map the new value; no tenant setting changes.

item.title: [New] Sending from aliases is generally available in Exchange Online: a user can send as any proxy address on the mailbox once the tenant switch is on
item.description:
With the switch on, the From address of an internal sender is no longer always the primary SMTP address. Detections, transport rules and investigations that key on the primary address miss mail sent from an alias, and an old alias on a retired domain becomes a sending identity again.

Exchange Online · Before enabling it, mark domains that should never send as Receive Only and check that sender-based rules and hunting queries resolve aliases to the mailbox.
